cohort: The study included 1,598,043 women who delivered in Canadian hospitals between April 1993 and March 2003, after excluding those with chronic kidney disease, diabetes mellitus, and other specific conditions.
finding: Pregnancy complicated with hypertensive disorders during pregnancy (HDPs) was significantly associated with an increased risk of end-stage renal disease hospitalization in later life, with the association varying by HDP subtype and frequency of delivery (e.g., pre-eclampsia/eclampsia aHR=4.7, gestational hypertension aHR=3.3).
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was identified as a significant correlate with subsequent ESRD hospitalization.
followup_time: Up to 20 years (from delivery between April 1993-March 2003, followed up through March 31, 2013)
